name: openai-to-gemini-transformer
description: Translates OpenAI Chat Completions requests into the Google Gemini generateContent API format and rewrites non-streaming and streaming Gemini responses back into OpenAI-compatible JSON or Chat Completions Server-Sent Events. Supports system prompts, multi-modal image input, tool/function calling, and both routed (multi-provider) and unconditional (single-provider) execution modes.
